name: Steam Train
desc: Side-view steam locomotive as a vintage travel poster: driving wheels and connecting rods roll to the beat while it steams past a line of telegraph poles and billows dark smoke from the funnel; blueprint, banknote-engraving and noir skins.

style.doc: aesthetic: art-deco travel poster / technical blueprint / banknote engraving / chiaroscuro noir

act.doc: multi-minute program: steady chug / fast express with streaks / station stop venting steam
